import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
import sys

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

from agent_core import EventLogger, RuntimeState, SourceRegistry, ToolExecutor


HAVE_GIT = shutil.which("git") is not None
HAVE_PYTHON = shutil.which("python3") is not None
needs_runtime = unittest.skipUnless(HAVE_GIT and HAVE_PYTHON, "git/python3 fehlen")


class VerificationScriptsV0223Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_runtime(self):
        td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(td.cleanup)
        root = Path(td.name)
        workspace = root / "workspace"
        workspace.mkdir()
        (workspace / "README.md").write_text("baseline\n", encoding="utf-8")
        subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-b", "main"], cwd=workspace, check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.name", "Test"], cwd=workspace, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.email", "test@example.invalid"], cwd=workspace, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=workspace, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "baseline"], cwd=workspace, check=True, capture_output=True)

        state = RuntimeState(task="Verifiziere Verhalten.", job_id="v0223", workspace=workspace, branch="ai/test")
        logger = EventLogger(root / "events.jsonl", quiet=True)
        sources = SourceRegistry(root / "sources.json")
        return root, workspace, state, logger, sources

    @needs_runtime
    def test_ad_hoc_script_needs_real_failure_contract(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        executor = ToolExecutor(state, logger, sources)

        (workspace / "final_check.py").write_text(
            'print("all requirements verified")\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        (workspace / "test_behavior.py").write_text(
            'assert len("abc") == 3\nprint("behavior ok")\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.assertFalse(executor._is_test_command("python3 final_check.py"))
        self.assertTrue(executor._is_test_command("python3 test_behavior.py"))

    @needs_runtime
    def test_successful_ad_hoc_test_is_recorded_and_cleanup_preserves_verification(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        executor = ToolExecutor(state, logger, sources)

        executor.write_file({
            "path": "test_behavior.py",
            "content": 'assert len("abc") == 3\nprint("behavior ok")\n',
        })
        result = executor.shell({"command": "python3 test_behavior.py"})

        self.assertIn("exit=0", result)
        self.assertTrue(state.latest_mutation_verified)
        self.assertEqual(state.successful_tests[-1]["command"], "python3 test_behavior.py")
        self.assertIn("behavior ok", state.successful_tests[-1]["output"])

        epoch = state.mutation_epoch
        verified = state.verified_epoch
        executor.shell({"command": "rm test_behavior.py"})

        self.assertEqual(state.mutation_epoch, epoch)
        self.assertEqual(state.verified_epoch, verified)
        self.assertTrue(state.latest_mutation_verified)
        self.assertNotIn("test_behavior.py", state.files_changed)

        events = (root / "events.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("Temporäre ungetrackte Verifikationsdatei", events)

    @needs_runtime
    def test_tracked_test_file_deletion_is_still_a_real_mutation(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        tracked = workspace / "test_product.py"
        tracked.write_text('assert True\n', encoding="utf-8")
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "test_product.py"], cwd=workspace, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "tracked test"], cwd=workspace, check=True, capture_output=True)

        executor = ToolExecutor(state, logger, sources)
        executor.shell({"command": "rm test_product.py"})

        self.assertEqual(state.mutation_epoch, 1)
        self.assertIn("test_product.py", state.files_changed)
        self.assertFalse(state.latest_mutation_verified)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
